caption: The drawing depicts three glass bottles, each rendered in shades of amber and brown. The largest bottle, positioned centrally at the bottom, is oval-shaped with a short, cylindrical neck. Its front face displays a raised design of a cornucopia filled with fruit. To the upper left, a smaller, vertically-oriented bottle is shown, featuring an elongated profile with embossed patterns running vertically down its sides. In the upper right, another small bottle with a rounded body and a short neck is illustrated; its front face has a relief motif of an eagle with a shield, wings spread, and some decorative foliage beneath. All three bottles are drawn against a plain, lightly-toned background with some areas showing brownish discoloration at the edges.
title: Flask
